name: read-only-doc-registry-search
description: Search the OMBrain documentation registry for paths matching a keyword. Read-only; no filesystem writes.

deterministic_steps.action: Load docs registry index from local brain memory
Filter entries by keyword and optional path prefix
Return matching paths and titles to operator

model_advisory_steps: Suggest related doc clusters if keyword is ambiguous
Note stale registry entries if last_scan is older than policy
verification_steps: Confirm query is read-only GET against docs registry
rollback_or_disable_plan: Reject procedure slug read-only-doc-registry-search via POST /brain/procedures/read-only-doc-registry-search/reject
